profile: overfitting: Overfitting begins when a highly complex model fits the given data extremely well, at the cost of not representing the underlying phenomenon well. This language is used because such models prioritize fitting the data over capturing the underlying relationship. The term thus indicates a trade-off between matching observed data and representing the real-world phenomenon.
